verdict.rationale: LobeHub says each agent has persistent memory that the user can edit (lobe-chat-docs-16), which implies the user can inspect it. The privacy page says chat data is stored locally on the client by default (lobe-chat-docs-44), and the desktop app is described as running locally (lobe-chat-docs-20). However, a 'Migrate from Local Database' guide (lobe-chat-docs-30) hints that local storage is being moved away from, and nothing shows the memory store itself is on-device or in an open format. Missing for 10: explicit memory deletion, evidence the memory store lives on the user's machine, an open/inspectable storage format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
